summary: Wellgistics Health filed an 8-K regarding a securities purchase agreement with accredited investors to issue convertible promissory notes and warrants, raising $16.9M net with a 20% OID. The filing details the convertible instrument, including automatic conversion into Series A Preferred stock after certain conditions. This is a structured financing, not a special situation involving M&A, activism, or strategic change. As a capital-raising transaction under Item 1.01 and 3.02, it does not fit any special-situations category. The deal carries no premium, board recommendation, or deal timeline typical of M&A.
